list.title: Agents
list.subtitle: User-created reviewers. Each = provider + model + system prompt + linked skills.
list.emptyBody: An agent is a configured reviewer — a model, a prompt, and the skills it uses. Create one to start reviewing.

create.title: Create agent
create.subtitle: An agent is a configured reviewer — a model, a prompt, and the skills it uses.
create.defaultSystemPrompt: You are a code reviewer. Examine the diff and return at most 5 high-value findings, each citing an exact file:line.

editor.loadErrorBody: The agent could not be loaded.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.modelHint: Models are loaded dynamically from the provider's /models.
config.modelEmptyHint: No models loaded — set the {provider} API key in Settings → API Keys.
config.systemPromptHint: Loaded as the static system message. Enabled skills are appended below it.
config.strategyHint: How the diff is sent to the model. Single pass = whole diff in one call (recommended); map-reduce = one call per file (for very large PRs); auto = single pass, switching to map-reduce on large diffs.

strategyOptions.single-pass: Single pass — whole diff in one call
strategyOptions.auto: Auto — single pass, map-reduce when large

config.ciFailOnHint: In GitHub Actions only: when should this agent's review block the PR (request changes + fail the check) vs just comment? Decided by finding severity, not the model. No effect on reviews shown in the studio.
config.repoIntelHint: Inject repo context (repo skeleton, callers of changed symbols, and a 'high blast-radius' note) into this agent's review prompt. On by default. Turning it off sends only the diff — useful for cheap models or self-contained PRs.

skills.title: Skills
skills.orderHint: Order matters — earlier skills appear earlier in the assembled prompt. Toggle to attach.

context.title: Project context
context.hint: Order matters — earlier docs appear earlier in the assembled `## Project context` block. Toggle to attach.
context.noRepo: No repository selected — select a repo to browse its context documents.

mount.body: Mount point for {owner}. The Agent Editor shell + tab routing are wired by A2 — {owner} renders this tab.

evals.title: Evals
evals.excludedSkillOwned: {count} skill-owned eval case(s) are not shown here — manage them from the owning skill.

empty.title: No eval cases yet
empty.hint: Accept or dismiss a finding on a PR, then use "Add to evals" on its card to turn it into a regression case — or author one by hand.

editor.name: Name
editor.subtitleManual: {agent} · simulate a PR and assert the expected output
editor.subtitleAccepted: Seeded from an accepted finding · assert the expected output
editor.subtitleDismissed: Seeded from a dismissed finding · assert the expected output
editor.filesEmpty: No files detected in the diff.
editor.assertEmptyComment: // dismissed — agent must produce no finding here

history.title: Batch history
history.selectTwoHint: Select exactly two batches to compare.
history.compareFullOnly: Only full-batch runs can be compared.
history.clearHistoryConfirmBody: This deletes all batch history and trend for this agent. Cases are kept.

trend.title: Trend
trend.empty: Not enough full-batch runs yet to plot a trend.
trend.linkHint: Hover a point to highlight its run in Batch History above.
trend.markersLabel: Plotted batches — hover a row for its snapshot & cost
trend.excludedNote: {count} batch(es) not plotted — all cases errored (no metrics to chart)
trend.singleBatchNote: Only one batch so far — run at least one more to plot a trend line.

kpiDelta.label: vs. previous batch
kpiDelta.noBaseline: No baseline yet — needs at least 2 full batches to show a KPI delta.
